title: About
description: About Timothy Vlangas: composer, sound recordist, game maker and artist, making things as Starry Sidekick.

elements.body:
I’m Timothy Vlangas, and Starry Sidekick is the name I make things under.

I have been working on film projects since 2017, and these days I work as a composer and sound recordist, which takes in boom operation and mixing. I work for, and am a graduate of, HUDSY, a nonprofit film studio in Kingston, New York.

People around me know me as a generalist problem solver, leaning toward anything and everything to do with sound and music. I have made albums, played live, made a video game, and worked on a web series, where I learned the ins and outs of a film set and how to get the day’s work done as joyfully as possible.

Everything is here: films, games, music, inventions, art and writing. To say hello, write me a letter, or find me through the links.
